## opencode-sonarqube v2.1.3

SonarQube plugin for OpenCode - enterprise-grade code quality analysis.

### Features
- Auto-analyze code on session idle
- Quality Gate status injection into system prompt  
- Security hotspot review via API (NEW)
- Support for 25+ languages
- Clean as You Code (new code focus)

### Installation
```bash
npm install opencode-sonarqube
```

See [README](https://github.com/mguttmann/opencode-sonarqube#readme) for documentation.
